scope: One Smarter Justice professional identity and firm organization layer across independent legal portals.
rules: One professional account across qualifying legal portals.
One firm organization account with offices and professional seats.
Individual evidence before specialty or portal assignment.
Payment never buys verification, placement, ranking, inquiries, clients, or outcomes.
Corrections, disputes, suppression, and removal never require payment.
Canonical mapping occurs only when unambiguous.
Portal exports are read-only and nonconfidential.
Dedicated portals remain authoritative for specialty rendering, evidence, safeguards, deployment, and user data.
